senses.gloss:
होरा होरा, f. (borrowed fr. Gr. ὥρα), the
rising of a zodiacal sign; part of the duration of a
sign; an hour; a mark, line; a particular scientific
work or science, (probably astrological.)
—होरा-
फल, अम्, n. the result or effect of the rising of a
sign.
—होरा-मकरन्द, N. of an astrological
work.
—होरा-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a work by
Satya.
—होरा-सार-सुधानिधि, N. of a work by
Nārāyaṇa.
होरिलसिंह होरिल-सिंह, अस्, m. a proper N.
